intro.title: Welcome!
intro.message: On the next screen you will see a short social media feed. Please scroll through it and look at the posts as you normally would. You can like, follow, save or share posts if you want to.
intro.subMessage: After every few posts, we will ask you a few short questions.

survey.recognitionTitle: Which topics did you notice in the last {count} posts?
survey.localizationTitle: In which posts did you notice these topics?
survey.saveError: Your answers could not be saved. Please check your internet connection and click Next again.
